method: Execute the current flyTo function extracted through the TypeScript AST, with isolated camera ownership state and a FakeMap that emits synchronous moveend on interrupted animation.
scope: Camera request ownership, cancellation, pending readiness, event order, cleanup. Does not verify rendered map position, real browser animation, SceneStudio effect wiring, or layout.

cases.description: Stopping the old flight settles only the old promise; the new flight remains active.
Aborting the old controller cannot stop a newer owned flight.
Aborting the current owner stops its flight and removes listeners and timer.
Scene cleanup cannot stop a newer flight started outside the scene without a signal.
When the map arrives late, only the latest queued request launches.
A request aborted before map readiness never starts an animation.
A late old map instance cannot receive the queued camera request after replacement.
The timeout fallback resolves and removes listeners without forcing a camera stop.
Invalid coordinates and already-aborted requests do not move the map.
A map animation error settles the request and removes its timer and listener.
